draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1 (81.6>80.9), r2 (88.3>87.1), r4 (76.4>75.6), r5 (84.9>84.1), r6 (90.2>89.0) = 5 of 6; Arbor-GBT higher only on r3 (92.8>92.3). "Most" (5/6) is accurate. No significance claim made, so no test needed.
